data.name: Out Of The Shadows (2025)
data.detailed_description:
“Ten years behind bars for a crime I didn’t commit. Tonight, it ends.”

Out of the Shadows is a third-person stealth adventure thriller about escaping a high-security prison and uncovering a deadly conspiracy. You play as Dr. Graham Ellington, a scientist framed for leaking nuclear secrets. After a decade in isolation, a mysterious note offers one final chance at freedom.

Sneak through shadow-drenched corridors, outsmart patrolling guards, and use light manipulation, blind spots, and environmental stealth to stay undetected. Every sound matters — every move could expose you.

As you escape the prison, uncover hidden clues about who framed you and why. What begins as a story of survival turns into a pursuit of truth, revenge, and redemption.

Key Features

  • Stealth Gameplay: Hide in shadows, disable lights, throw objects, and silently take down guards.

  • Cinematic Storytelling: Experience an emotional narrative driven by voiceovers, atmosphere, and tension.

  • Environmental Puzzles: Find keys, disable power grids, and manipulate your surroundings to escape.

  • Immersive Audio & Visuals: Dynamic lighting, echoing footsteps, and environmental ambience build a tense prison world.

  • Linear, Story-Rich Experience: A focused 20–25 minutes stealth adventure.

Escape. Survive. Uncover the truth.

Out of the Shadows is perfect for players who love story-rich stealth games, cinematic adventures, and tense, atmospheric escapes where every step counts.

  • Processor: Intel I5 / Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 11
